question: In 2022 the Commission accepted a series of commitments from Insurance Ireland following a competition investigation, the implementation of which were to be monitored by a trustee who was to report to the Commission. Can the Commission outline the number of reports it has received to date and publish these reports?
answer: EN on behalf of the European Commission (8.5.2024) Following the adoption of a Commission decision pursuant to Article 9 of Regulation 1/20031 and the commitments made binding upon Insurance Ireland, a Monitoring Trustee was appointed on 29 July 2022 and for a duration of 10 years. To date, the Monitoring Trustee has provided three reports on the compliance with the commitments.

The Monitoring Trustee reports contain confidential information, and therefore cannot be published. The Commission with the assistance of the Monitoring Trustee will continue to monitor closely the implementation of the commitments.
1 Council Regulation (EC) No 1/2003 of 16 December 2002 on the implementation of the rules on competition
laid down in Articles 81 and 82 of the Treaty, OJ L 1, 4.1.2003, p. 1–25.
